absent: Numeric addresses for machine check and scalable MCA model specific registers.
Bit definitions for status and global status fields beyond the encodings summarized in findings.
Machine check polling and logging and recovery procedures.
Corrected interrupt discovery and support detection algorithms.
Processor topology and online state and cross processor call primitives.
Platform configuration register layout beyond the single forwarding enable observed.
Debug filesystem creation and permission enforcement semantics.
Injector notifier chain behavior when compiled in.
Storm window timing source and transition hysteresis beyond threshold values.
Nonmaskable descriptor table sizing and remaining nonmaskable operations.

findings.text: The lane exposes a nonmaskable interrupt subscription removal operation addressed by interrupt type and textual handler name. Lookup uses name equality within the per type descriptor and an absent name leaves state unchanged while a present name is detached and later made reusable after a grace period. Descriptor selection is by indexing a table with the supplied type.

Bank selection is validated against the bank population reported by the chosen target processor rather than a global constant so heterogeneous populations are handled. Out of range selections are rejected without side effects while in range selections are retained. For scalable hardware configurations an additional population probe rejects empty banks whereas software only selection bypasses that probe because it exercises decoding paths only.

Deferred error injection is normalized to a deferred and non uncorrected encoding while global restartability marking is derived from the processor context corrupt indication. Global machine check in progress and error instruction pointer validity are always asserted for hardware paths.

Register programming distinguishes scalable from legacy machine check register families and within the scalable family distinguishes deferred reporting registers from normal status registers. Syndrome information is always programmed in the scalable family while miscellaneous information is programmed only when nonzero preserving the validity encoding expected by consumers.

On multi node AMD configurations with an older processor family errors for a specific northbridge bank are redirected to the node base core computed from per package thread count and node count. Before redirection the northbridge forwarding enable is ensured making the operation effective even when firmware left it disabled.

Northbridge forwarding enable uses read modify write with early exits when topology lookup fails or the function device is absent or configuration read fails or the enable is already set. A write is attempted only to set the enable and failures are reported without further action.

Error severity classification is an ordered first match table from most specific panic conditions through action required and action optional cases to generic fallbacks ending with an unconditional catch all. Earlier entries therefore shadow later ones and coverage tracking records which entries have matched.

Severity table construction uses small helper shorthands that fill severity code and message and bank interval and processor identity and stepping and execution context and feature requirement and exception context and status mask pairs and global status mask pairs and combined uncorrected flag groupings. These shorthands keep individual table entries compact while preserving first match evaluation semantics.

Removal of a nonmaskable handler serializes list traversal and mutation with an interrupt saving raw spin lock owned by the per type descriptor performs deletion with read copy update semantics releases the lock and only then waits for readers before reinitializing the detached entry. This allows concurrent lock free readers during lookup while ensuring safe reclamation.

Corrected machine check polling of the current processor poll set is serialized by a single global spin lock held across the entire poll preventing concurrent polls on the same processor from interleaving.

Hardware injection holds the processor hotplug read lock while checking target online state and while programming and signalling the target so the target cannot go offline mid operation. The lock is always released on both success and early exit paths.

Global machine check configuration aggregates single bit control flags and operational booleans and timeout controls and a restart address selector and a boot logging control. The bit packed portion reserves most bits for future use while the boolean portion controls logging and thresholding and verbosity behaviors.

Vendor capability state packs nine single bit capability and quirk indicators with a large reserved area. The indicators distinguish recovery support and scalable register support and thresholding style and legacy processor families and several model specific instruction and fetch quirks.

Storm tracking keeps per bank history as a fixed width bitmask plus a timestamp and two mode flags distinguishing storm entry from poll only operation. A container holds one such record per possible bank together with a count of stormy banks and a global poll mode selector. History width equals the number of bits in a machine word.

A severity rule combines a status mask and expected value and a global status mask and expected value and severity and control bytes for required features and execution context and exception context and a coverage marker and processor identity and minimum stepping and an inclusive bank interval and a descriptive message. Supporting enumerations encode execution contexts and feature requirements and exception contexts as small positive integers.

Per bank control state pairs a subevent enable mask with initialization and address format flags. Machine check register selection is a four valued enumeration covering control and status and address and miscellaneous roles in a fixed order. Event queuing pairs a lock free list node with a full hardware error record.

Writing the bank selector is the commit point for an injection where validation precedes any hardware effect and the injection itself follows and the shared injection record is reinitialized afterward so stale values cannot leak into the next operation. Validation failures abort before any programming or signalling.

Injection dispatch separates local decoding from hardware signalling. Local decoding completes synchronously without cross processor work. Hardware paths program the target then emit exactly one of three signals corresponding to deferred and threshold and machine check delivery with machine check as the default.

Unregistering transitions from locked search to optional detachment to unlocked reclamation. If no entry matches the operation ends after unlocking with no waiting. If an entry matches detachment occurs under lock and reclamation waits for readers after unlocking before the entry is made reusable.

Severity coverage export iterates the rule table by position with bounds checked start and advance operations and a no operation termination hook. Reading reports per rule coverage alongside its message while any write clears all coverage markers and reports the supplied length as consumed providing a resettable observability channel.

Hardware injection capability is probed once at startup on scalable systems by testing writability of the first populated bank on the current processor within a temporary injection window. A non sticky write marks hardware injection as unavailable and emits a warning suggesting an alternate firmware based mechanism while absence of scalable support skips probing entirely.

Initialization allocates per system tracking state and probes capability and publishes debug interfaces and subscribes to nonmaskable notifications and injector events and prepares a clean injection record. Teardown reverses this in safe order by unsubscribing and removing interfaces and clearing interface descriptors and freeing tracking state.

The injector publishes a directory with a small set of attribute files for error details and target selection and bank selection and injection mode plus a read only overview document. Attribute files allow owner read and write and the overview allows broader read access and all attribute writes share a common backing record with bank writes triggering the operation.

Threshold handling provides three timely entry points where an interrupt handler polls owned banks with timestamping and a rediscovery worker refreshes bank knowledge when the feature is present to tolerate heterogeneity and a locked poll helper serves the current processor poll set.

Severity coverage is exposed as a single debug file under the machine check debug directory with read only permission backed by sequential iteration operations and a write handler that resets coverage. Creation occurs during early initialization.
In this configuration the injector notifier registration operations are empty inline placeholders with no observable effect indicating the chain is compiled out while preserving call compatibility.

Hardware injection that marks processor context as corrupted risks a system panic in the machine check handler. Documentation advises staging a fake panic control before such injections and distinguishes safe local decoding from risky hardware delivery.

Attempting to remove a nonmaskable handler while executing in nonmaskable context emits a warning but still detaches the entry risking use after detachment for the in flight handler. Callers must therefore unregister from process context only.

Injection performs privileged side effects including platform configuration modification to enable northbridge forwarding and direct writes to machine check control and status registers on a remote processor. Incorrect target selection or concurrent use could corrupt error state or alter platform configuration persistently until reset.
The corrected interrupt baseline value is 1 and the storm detection value is 32749. Per bank threshold storage is sized by the maximum bank count.
Storm entry bound is 5 and storm exit poll bound is 29 and history width is 64 and the initial periodic check interval is five minutes.

Severity codes span 0 through 7 from no severity through deferred and keep and some and action optional and uncorrected and action required to panic with deferred and uncorrected no action required sharing value 1. Execution context spans 1 through 3 for kernel and user and recoverable kernel while feature requirement and exception context each span 1 through 2.

Machine check register roles are encoded as 0 through 3 in control and status and address and miscellaneous order. Diagnostic messages use a fixed short prefix and header inclusion uses a conventional guard symbol. One legacy enable uses read mostly placement and one threshold limit is a file private 32 bit value.
